files.description: Consult when a change touches any file in this repository: defines what the scraper is and is not, its commands, deploy path, credential model and data-handling constraints.

Consult when a change touches the row schema, runtime credentials or invocation auth: defines the BigQuery schema table, the delegation scopes, the runtime credential model and the downstream readers of the table.

Consult when a change reads an environment variable, loads credentials or depends on the scheduler request: defines the production env vars, the key mount, the invocation flags and the scheduler request body.
Consult when a change adds, renames or moves a Python module: defines which files the runtime image copies.
